past.company_description: An estimated 73% of organizations utilize test automation yet continue to struggle with low test coverage and long test cycle times. AquilaTest reduces these software testing bottlenecks.Our solution is a codeless test automation platform that reduces testing bottlenecks common in legacy automation tools. The key benefits include minimizing script maintenance times, streamlining a single test workflow across multiple apps, and integrating different testing types in a single platform.
past.description:
- Architected a multi-AI-agent system using Autogen and PostgreSQL to query PDFs and employed a RabbitMQ architecture to automate PDF-related test cases.
- Fine-tuned Llama 3 with QLoRA and instituted a RAG-LLM-based microservice with a Flask API to automate QA test flow segregation, streamlining client onboarding from months to minutes
- Developed a customer-service chatbot with Langchain based on company documentation and established a Cron job with AWS Lambda to retrieve up-to-date info from videos/docs in AWS S3, minimizing response time by 99%.
- Modularized code, integrated logging, engineered Flask APIs, and applied SOLID to refactor existing projects.
- Reported directly to the CEO and worked with him to ideate and execute in addressing client issues and conduct market research.

past.title: AI/ML Intern
